source.snippet: Trying to use the legacy uploader to upload a conversion with only a GBRAID. I don't have a GCLID. Is there a special format for this? I have a conversion that only has a GBRAID. I have tried putting the GBRAID into the Google Click ID field, but it says 'The imported gclid could not be decoded.'

problem_statement: Advertisers running Google Ads campaigns cannot upload offline conversions when they only have a GBRAID (app click ID) and no GCLID, because the legacy uploader rejects the format — causing conversion data gaps and misinformed bidding.
target_segment: Performance marketing managers and agencies running Google App campaigns with offline conversion tracking
notes: Advertiser context — people spending real money on Google Ads are losing attribution data. Conversion tracking gaps directly cost money in poor bidding decisions. A SaaS tool or middleware that handles GBRAID-to-conversion-upload pipeline would have a clear ROI story and could charge % of ad spend or flat monthly fee.
